plain: On a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, a guest named Dan Sheehan passes on the story of a woman named Carol, who says she was taken from her home aboard a craft by non-human beings in the 1990s. Sheehan says she had been studied by a researcher named John Mack, and that she was furious at the people who study UFOs, which are unexplained flying objects. As the story goes, she lost a pregnancy without explanation and came to believe she had a daughter who was part human and part alien. If true, it would mean that beings are making children with people.
